title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: On Monday a student told your makerspace assistant which printer they prefer. On Tuesday they open a new chat and the assistant does not know. Which explanation is correct?

options.text: The model forgot it, because older facts fade from the model over time
The window was too small, because Monday's chat used up all the space
Tuesday's chat started with an empty list, and nothing saved was loaded
The model only stores facts when the student confirms them out loud

items.stem: A request starts with 2,000 tokens (system prompt, tool definitions and the question). The model makes a 50-token tool request, gets a 500-token result, makes another 50-token tool request, gets a 1,500-token result, then writes a final answer. Each model call re-reads the whole history. How many input tokens are read in total across the three model calls?
Your manuals total 400 pages and each question needs one or two of them. Cost per request matters. Which design is best?

options.text: Put all 400 pages in the system prompt so nothing can be missed
Give the model a search tool that returns the few best passages
Train a model on the manuals so that it remembers every page
Put a one-paragraph summary of each manual in the system prompt

items.stem: What is the name for summarizing a conversation that is close to the context window limit, then continuing in a fresh window that starts with the summary?
Your assistant uses a memory tool that stores notes as files. The model decides to save a student's preference. Which statement describes what happens?

options.text: The model writes the file itself, straight into its own internal storage
The model updates its learned patterns, so every future student benefits
The provider's servers save the file, and your program never sees it
The model requests a file write, and your program carries it out
